resources.string: TrueVault will re-check what changed when you come back.
To display and launch apps from supported private profiles, TrueVault must become your Home app.\n\nThis changes your phone\'s main launcher. You can switch back at any time from Android settings.
TrueVault is currently your Home app.
TrueVault is not your Home app. Private profile apps cannot be listed or launched from here without it.
Hide icons from TrueVault\'s own launcher screen.
This is not app security. It removes icons from one launcher, nothing more.

Launcher Visibility only removes selected icons from TrueVault's launcher screen.

The apps remain installed and may still appear in Android Settings, system search, notifications, sharing menus or another launcher.

Uninstalling an app removes it completely.
Available only while TrueVault is your Home app.
Tap an app to hide or show its icon here. Every app stays installed either way.
TrueVault is not your Home app, so this is a preview. Private profile apps cannot be listed until you enable Secure Launcher Mode.

What this does, and what it does not

Changing the icon makes the app less noticeable on your home screen. It does not make it invisible: Android Settings, storage usage, battery usage and permission screens will still list this app under its real package. If someone looks there, they will find it.
Your vault is protected by your password or biometric, not by the icon. Changing the appearance never changes what it takes to open the vault.
The app under its own name and icon.
Opens to your personal notes. Your private vault stays behind authentication.
The same app, presented as a notes app.
The same app, presented as file organisation.

The new icon is active, but the previous one could not be removed. Try applying the appearance again, or restart your launcher.
